about: OwnershipStateMachine with the default policy, replayed call by call. Positions are 1/512 m grid units and velocities float32 bits. Each outcome is the result, reclaim reason, state, owner slot (0 is the server), epoch and whether it changed, then the machine's distance credit, yielding participant, yield deadline and whether a first sample is still owed. A grab, steal or catch needs the requester's avatar within the hold range of the body; a throw needs the body's last validated position within it of the holder; a grant with no sample by its deadline, a silent owner and a missing hand-back are reclaimed and make that participant yield for the cooldown, and so does a hand-back before the first sample. A request from another participant within the hold range, denied while the body is held, contests the hold; the owner of a contested hold yields once it hands back or fails validation, replacing any earlier cooldown. Every grant, a steal included, starts an uncontested hold. An uncontested hold that ends by a hand-back or a failed validation is remembered with its time until the body is granted or reclaimed; a request naming another epoch while the body is free, from another participant within the hold range, within the cooldown after that release, makes the releaser yield for the cooldown from then, once. A disconnect forgets the participant's cooldown and release. The last three outcome fields are whether the current hold is contested, the remembered releaser (0 for none) and its release time.

scenarios.name: short holds yield to stale requests
